name: maklik
title: Screenshot Upload
description: Capture screenshots, upload them to S3-compatible storage, and copy the public URL.
author: danieljvdm

preferences.name: region
preferences.title: Region
preferences.description: S3 region value used by the SDK.

preferences.name: publicBaseUrl
preferences.title: Public Base URL
preferences.description: Public URL prefix used for copied links.

preferences.name: keyPrefix
preferences.title: Key Prefix
preferences.description: Optional object key prefix, e.g. screenshots.

preferences.name: forcePathStyle
preferences.title: S3 Client
preferences.description: Use path-style requests for broader S3-compatible support.
preferences.label: Force path style

preferences.name: maxUploadBytes
preferences.title: Compression Target Bytes
preferences.description: Maximum upload size target in bytes.

preferences.name: maxRetries
preferences.title: Upload Retries
preferences.description: Maximum upload retries for transient failures.

commands.name: take-screenshot
commands.title: Take Screenshot
commands.description: Capture a region, compress, upload, and copy the URL.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
